versions.changelog:
gstack v1.1.0 introduces enhanced instructions and contributor workflows.

- Expanded documentation with detailed QA, dogfooding, and browser automation examples.
- Clear setup and upgrade flows for smoother initial setup and version upgrades.
- Standardized AskUserQuestion formatting for consistent user clarification.
- New Contributor Mode: prompts field reports for actionable tool improvements, guiding power users through easy feedback filing.
- Additional guidance for edge cases (build setup, binary requirements, session handling) to reduce setup friction.
